description.narrative: "The objective of this IDF grant is to assist the Government of Mozambique to strengthen the overall M&E framework, particularly the results orientation at sector level for the upcoming third Poverty Reduction Strategy (referred to as PARPA). The previous PARPA II included for the first time a results-based monitoring framework, expressed in a strategic matrix. The matrix was prepared by the Ministry of Planning and Development with the involvement of all line ministries and key agencies. The process also benefitted from the support of donor agencies, including technical assistance from the Bank. PARPA is operationalized through the Economic and Social Plan (Plano Económico e Social, PES), which is approved by the National Assembly. The performance of the previous year's PES implementation is assessed in the annual Progress Report of the Economic and Social Plan (BPES). PARPA's strategic matrix is also linked to the budget cycle. As Mozambique is well advanced in terms of donor harmonization, a large part of aid is provided through budget support (by a group of 19 donors, or ""G19""). A joint government-G19 group selected a subset of 40 PARPA indicators from the broader strategic matrix for a performance assessment framework (PAF), which serves as the monitoring framework for budget support. Progress is assessed within an annual joint review mechanism. This is considered best practice in terms of pursuing the country ownership goals of the Paris Declaration. In this respect, the PAF contributes to reduced transaction costs since separate reporting mechanisms to donors are no longer required. In order to facilitate a strengthened performance assessment framework with a meaningful subset of PARPA indicators for monitoring progress for general budget support, the Government and its donor partners would like to see an improved overall M&E framework for the upcoming PARPA III. This IDF grant therefore would assist the Ministry of Planning and Development in strengthening the overall M&E framework for PARPA III with a particular focus on: (i) Improving the results orientation at sector level by strengthening the logical linkage between different levels of results, and (ii) Improving the linkage between M&E and planning, by strengthening the capacity to relate budget and policy actions to PARPA (and PAF) results. The objective of this IDF grant is to strengthen the Government of Mozambique's capacity to coordinate the overall M&E framework for the upcoming third Poverty Reduction Strategy (referred to as PARPA) and, particularly, to strengthen the results orientation at sector level."
